224	Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
225	  match e with
226	  | exp_int P i => exp_int P i
227	  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
228	  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
229	  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs P V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
230	  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
231	  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs P V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
232	  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) V
233	  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs P Q (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
234	  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) Q
235	  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec (S k) f e2)
236	  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
237	  | exp_inr P e2 => exp_inr P (open_ee_rec k f e2)
238	  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
239	      exp_case (open_ee_rec k f e1)
240	               (open_ee_rec (S k) f e2)
241	               (open_ee_rec (S k) f e3)
242	  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair P (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
243	  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (open_ee_rec k f e1)
244	  | exp_second e2 => exp_second (open_ee_rec k f e2)
245	  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
246	  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label P l
247	  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (open_ee_rec k f e1)
248	  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
249	  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
250	  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
251	  | exp_without P e1 => exp_without P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
252	  | exp_do b => exp_do b
253	  | exp_if0 e1 e2 e3 =>

256	              (open_ee_rec k f e3)

Require Export Fsub.EffectExclusion.LabelMap.

Require Export Fsub.EffectExclusion.Label.

Require Export Fsub.FbMeta.Metatheory.

Require Export String.

Require Export Coq.ZArith.ZArith.

Require Export Fsub.EffectExclusion.Lattice.

Parameter B : Set.
Parameter O : Order B.
Parameter L : Lattice B.
Parameter LSet : @LOSet B O L.
Parameter D : @DistributiveLattice B L.
Parameter BA : @BooleanAlgebra B L D.
#[export] Existing Instances O L LSet D BA.

Inductive qua : Set :=
  | qua_base : B -> qua
  | qua_bvar : nat -> qua
  | qua_fvar : atom -> qua
  | qua_meet : qua -> qua -> qua
  | qua_join : qua -> qua -> qua
  | qua_negate : qua -> qua
.

Notation "`impure" := (qua_base top).

Notation "`pure" := (qua_base bot).

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top : typ
  | typ_int : typ
  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
  | typ_fvar : atom -> typ
  | typ_arrow : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_all : typ -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_qall : qua -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_sum : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_pair : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_ref : qtyp -> typ
with qtyp : Set :=
  | qtyp_qtyp : qua -> typ -> qtyp
.

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_int : qua -> Z -> exp
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : qua -> qtyp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tabs : qua -> typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
  | exp_qabs : qua -> qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_qapp : exp -> qua -> exp
  | exp_let : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_inl : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_inr : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_case : exp -> exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_pair : qua -> exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_first : exp -> exp
  | exp_second : exp -> exp
  | exp_ref : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_ref_label : qua -> label -> exp
  | exp_deref : exp -> exp
  | exp_set_ref : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_upqual : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_check : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_without : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_do : B -> exp
  | exp_if0 : exp -> exp -> exp -> exp
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Coercion qua_bvar : nat >-> qua.

Coercion qua_fvar : atom >-> qua.

Definition concrete_qua : Set := B.

Fixpoint concretize (q : qua) : (option concrete_qua) :=
  match q with
  | qua_base b => Some b
  | qua_fvar X => None
  | qua_bvar n => None
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 =>
    match (concretize Q1, concretize Q2) with
    | (Some b1, Some b2) => Some (b1 ⊔ b2)
    | _ => None
    end
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 =>
    match (concretize Q1, concretize Q2) with
    | (Some b1, Some b2) => Some (b1 ⊓ b2)
    | _ => None
    end
  | qua_negate Q1 =>
    match (concretize Q1) with
    | Some b1 => Some (negate b1)
    | None => None
    end
  end.

Definition abstractize (s : concrete_qua) :=
  qua_base s.

Fixpoint open_qq_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (Q : qua)  {struct Q} : qua :=
  match Q with
  | qua_base b => qua_base b
  | qua_bvar J => if (K == J) then R else (qua_bvar J)
  | qua_fvar X => qua_fvar X
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 => qua_meet (open_qq_rec K R Q1) (open_qq_rec K R Q2)
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 => qua_join (open_qq_rec K R Q1) (open_qq_rec K R Q2)
  | qua_negate Q1 => qua_negate (open_qq_rec K R Q1)
  end.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_int => typ_int
  | typ_bvar J => if K == J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_qall Q T => typ_qall Q (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => typ_sum (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => typ_pair (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_ref T1 => typ_ref (open_tqt_rec K U T1)
  end
with open_tqt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : qtyp)  {struct T} : qtyp :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T => qtyp_qtyp Q (open_tt_rec K U T)
  end.

Fixpoint open_qt_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_int => typ_int
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_qqt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec (S K) R T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_qt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec (S K) R T2)
  | typ_qall Q T => typ_qall (open_qq_rec K R Q) (open_qqt_rec (S K) R T)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => typ_sum (open_qqt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec K R T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => typ_pair (open_qqt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec K R T2)
  | typ_ref T1 => typ_ref (open_qqt_rec K R T1)
  end
with open_qqt_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (T : qtyp)  {struct T} : qtyp :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T => qtyp_qtyp (open_qq_rec K R Q) (open_qt_rec K R T)
  end.

Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_int Q i => exp_int Q i
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs P (open_tqt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs P (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs P Q (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (open_te_rec K U e1) Q
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec (S K) U e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl P (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_inr P e2 => exp_inr P (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_case (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec (S K) U e2) (open_te_rec (S K) U e3)
  | exp_pair R e1 e2 => exp_pair R (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_second e2 => exp_second (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref P (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label P l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check P (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual P (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_without P e1 => exp_without P (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_do b => exp_do b
  | exp_if0 e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_if0 (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2) (open_te_rec K U e3)
  end.

Fixpoint open_qe_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_int P i => exp_int (open_qq_rec K R P) i
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qqt_rec K R V)  (open_qe_rec (S K) R e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qt_rec K R V)  (open_qe_rec (S K) R e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qt_rec K R V)
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qq_rec K R Q)  (open_qe_rec (S K) R e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qq_rec K R Q)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec (S K) R e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_inr P e2 => exp_inr (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_case (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec (S K) R e2) (open_qe_rec (S K) R e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_second e2 => exp_second (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label (open_qq_rec K R P) l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_without P e1 => exp_without (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_do b => exp_do b
  | exp_if0 e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_if0 (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec K R e2) (open_qe_rec K R e3)
  end.

Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_int P i => exp_int P i
  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs P V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs P V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) V
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs P Q (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) Q
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec (S k) f e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_inr P e2 => exp_inr P (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_case (open_ee_rec k f e1)
               (open_ee_rec (S k) f e2)
               (open_ee_rec (S k) f e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair P (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_second e2 => exp_second (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label P l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_without P e1 => exp_without P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_do b => exp_do b
  | exp_if0 e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_if0 (open_ee_rec k f e1)
              (open_ee_rec k f e2)
              (open_ee_rec k f e3)
  end.

Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.

Definition open_te e U := open_te_rec 0 U e.

Definition open_ee e1 e2 := open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1.

Definition open_qq Q R := open_qq_rec 0 R Q.

Definition open_qe e R := open_qe_rec 0 R e.

Definition open_qt T R := open_qt_rec 0 R T.

Definition open_qqt T R := open_qqt_rec 0 R T.

Definition open_tqt T R := open_tqt_rec 0 R T.

Inductive qual : qua -> Prop :=
  | qual_base : forall b,
      qual (qua_base b)
  | qual_fvar : forall (X : atom),
      qual (qua_fvar X)
  | qual_meet : forall Q1 Q2,
      qual Q1 ->
      qual Q2 ->
      qual (qua_meet Q1 Q2)
  | qual_join : forall Q1 Q2,
      qual Q1 ->
      qual Q2 ->
      qual (qua_join Q1 Q2)
  | qual_negate : forall Q1,
      qual Q1 ->
      qual (qua_negate Q1)
.

Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_int :
      type typ_int
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      qtype T1 ->
      qtype T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> qtype (open_tqt T2 X)) ->
      type (typ_all T1 T2)
  | type_qall : forall L Q T,
      qual Q ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> qtype (open_qqt T X)) ->
      type (typ_qall Q T)
  | type_sum : forall T1 T2,
      qtype T1 ->
      qtype T2 ->
      type (typ_sum T1 T2)
  | type_pair : forall T1 T2,
      qtype T1 ->
      qtype T2 ->
      type (typ_pair T1 T2)
with qtype : qtyp -> Prop :=
  | qtype_qtyp : forall Q T,
      qual Q ->
      type T ->
      qtype (qtyp_qtyp Q T)
.

Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | expr_int : forall P i,
      qual P ->
      expr (exp_int P i)
  | expr_var : forall x,
      expr (exp_fvar x)
  | expr_abs : forall L P T e1,
      qual P ->
      qtype T ->
      qual P ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e1 x)) ->
      expr (exp_abs P T e1)
  | expr_app : forall e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_app e1 e2)
  | expr_tabs : forall L P T e1,
      qual P ->
      type T ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_te e1 X)) ->
      expr (exp_tabs P T e1)
  | expr_tapp : forall e1 V,
      expr e1 ->
      type V ->
      expr (exp_tapp e1 V)
  | expr_qabs : forall L P Q e1,
      qual P ->
      qual Q ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_qe e1 X)) ->
      expr (exp_qabs P Q e1)
  | expr_qapp : forall e1 Q,
      expr e1 ->
      qual Q ->
      expr (exp_qapp e1 Q)
  | expr_let : forall L e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e2 x)) ->
      expr (exp_let e1 e2)
  | expr_inl : forall P e1,
      qual P ->
      expr e1 ->
      expr (exp_inl P e1)
  | expr_inr : forall P e1,
      qual P ->
      expr e1 ->
      expr (exp_inr P e1)
  | expr_case : forall L e1 e2 e3,
      expr e1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e2 x)) ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e3 x)) ->
      expr (exp_case e1 e2 e3)
  | expr_pair : forall P e1 e2,
      qual P ->
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_pair P e1 e2)
  | expr_first : forall e1,
      expr e1 ->
      expr (exp_first e1)
  | expr_second : forall e1,
      expr e1 ->
      expr (exp_second e1)
  | expr_upqual : forall P e1,
      qual P ->
      expr e1 ->
      expr (exp_upqual P e1)
  | expr_check : forall P e1,
      qual P ->
      expr e1 ->
      expr (exp_check P e1)
  | expr_without : forall P e1,
        qual P ->
        expr e1 ->
        expr (exp_without P e1)
  | expr_do : forall b,
        expr (exp_do b)
  | expr_if0 : forall e1 e2 e3,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr e3 ->
      expr (exp_if0 e1 e2 e3)
.

Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : typ -> binding
  | bind_typ : qtyp -> binding
  | bind_qua : qua -> binding.

Notation env := (list (atom * binding)).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive wf_qua : env -> qua -> Prop :=
  | wf_qua_base : forall E b,
      wf_qua E (qua_base b)
  | wf_qua_fvar : forall R E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_qua R) E ->
      wf_qua E (qua_fvar X)
  | wf_qua_meet : forall E Q1 Q2,
      wf_qua E Q1 ->
      wf_qua E Q2 ->
      wf_qua E (qua_meet Q1 Q2)
  | wf_qua_join : forall E Q1 Q2,
      wf_qua E Q1 ->
      wf_qua E Q2 ->
      wf_qua E (qua_join Q1 Q2)
  | wf_qua_negate : forall E Q1,
      wf_qua E Q1 ->
      wf_qua E (qua_negate Q1)
.

Notation "E |-q Q wf" := (wf_qua E Q) (at level 70).

Inductive wf_typ : env -> typ -> Prop :=
  | wf_typ_top : forall E,
      wf_typ E typ_top
  | wf_typ_int : forall E,
      wf_typ E typ_int
  | wf_typ_var : forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X)
  | wf_typ_arrow : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_qtyp E T1 ->
      wf_qtyp E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        wf_qtyp (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tqt T2 X)) ->
      wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_qall : forall L E T1 T2,
      wf_qua E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        wf_qtyp (X ~ bind_qua T1 ++ E) (open_qqt T2 X)) ->
      wf_typ E (typ_qall T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_sum : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_qtyp E T1 ->
      wf_qtyp E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_sum T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_pair : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_qtyp E T1 ->
      wf_qtyp E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_pair T1 T2)
with wf_qtyp : env -> qtyp -> Prop :=
  | wf_qtyp_qtyp : forall E Q T,
      wf_qua E Q ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_qtyp E (qtyp_qtyp Q T)
.

Notation "E |-t T wf" := (wf_typ E T) (at level 70).

Notation "E |-qt T wf" := (wf_qtyp E T) (at level 70).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : qtyp),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qtyp E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E)
  | wf_env_qua : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (Q : qua),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E Q ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_qua Q ++ E)
.

Notation "|- E wf" := (wf_env E) (at level 70).

Inductive subqual : env -> qua -> qua -> Prop :=
  | subqual_top : forall E Q,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E Q ->
      subqual E Q (qua_base top)
  | subqual_bot : forall E Q,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E Q ->
      subqual E (qua_base bot) Q
  | subqual_eval_elim : forall E Q' Q R b,
      subqual E Q Q' ->
      concretize Q' = Some b ->
      subqual E (qua_base b) R ->
      subqual E Q R
  | subqual_eval_intro : forall E Q' Q R b,
      subqual E Q' R ->
      concretize Q' = Some b ->
      subqual E Q (qua_base b) ->
      subqual E Q R
  | subqual_lift_elem : forall E b1 b2,
      wf_env E ->
      ord b1 b2 ->
      subqual E (qua_base b1) (qua_base b2)
  | subqual_refl_qvar : forall E X,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E (qua_fvar X) ->
      subqual E (qua_fvar X) (qua_fvar X)
  | subqual_trans_qvar : forall R E Q X,
      binds X (bind_qua R) E ->
      subqual E R Q ->
      subqual E (qua_fvar X) Q
  | subqual_join_inl : forall E R1 R2 Q,
      subqual E Q R1 ->
      wf_qua E R2 ->
      subqual E Q (qua_join R1 R2)
  | subqual_join_inr : forall E R1 R2 Q,
      wf_qua E R1 ->
      subqual E Q R2 ->
      subqual E Q (qua_join R1 R2)
  | subqual_join_elim : forall E R1 R2 Q,
      subqual E R1 Q ->
      subqual E R2 Q ->
      subqual E (qua_join R1 R2) Q
  | subqual_meet_eliml : forall E R1 R2 Q,
      subqual E R1 Q ->
      wf_qua E R2 ->
      subqual E (qua_meet R1 R2) Q
  | subqual_meet_elimr : forall E R1 R2 Q,
      wf_qua E R1 ->
      subqual E R2 Q ->
      subqual E (qua_meet R1 R2) Q
  | subqual_meet_intro : forall E R1 R2 Q,
      subqual E Q R1 ->
      subqual E Q R2 ->
      subqual E Q (qua_meet R1 R2)
  | subqual_dist : forall E Q R S,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E Q ->
      wf_qua E R ->
      wf_qua E S ->
      subqual E (qua_meet Q (qua_join R S))
                (qua_join (qua_meet Q R) (qua_meet Q S))
  | subqual_trans : forall E Q R S,
      subqual E Q R ->
      subqual E R S ->
      subqual E Q S
  | subqual_negate_intro : forall E Q,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E Q ->
      subqual E (qua_base top) (qua_join Q (qua_negate Q))
  | subqual_negate_elim : forall E Q,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E Q ->
      subqual E (qua_meet Q (qua_negate Q)) (qua_base bot)
  | subqual_refl_negate : forall E Q,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E Q ->
      subqual E (qua_negate Q) (qua_negate Q)
.

Notation "E |-sq Q1 <: Q2" := (subqual E Q1 Q2) (at level 70).

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | sub_top : forall E S,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E S ->
      sub E S typ_top
  | sub_refl_int : forall E,
      wf_env E ->
      sub E typ_int typ_int
  | sub_refl_tvar : forall E X,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X) ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
  | sub_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
  | sub_arrow : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      subqtype E T1 S1 ->
      subqtype E S2 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_arrow S1 S2) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | sub_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          subqtype (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tqt S2 X) (open_tqt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_all S1 S2) (typ_all T1 T2)
  | sub_qall : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      subqual E T1 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          subqtype (X ~ bind_qua T1 ++ E) (open_qqt S2 X) (open_qqt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_qall S1 S2) (typ_qall T1 T2)
  | sub_sum : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      subqtype E S1 T1 ->
      subqtype E S2 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_sum S1 S2) (typ_sum T1 T2)
  | sub_pair : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      subqtype E S1 T1 ->
      subqtype E S2 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_pair S1 S2) (typ_pair T1 T2)
with subqtype : env -> qtyp -> qtyp -> Prop :=
  | sub_qtyp_qtyp : forall E Q1 T1 Q2 T2,
      subqual E Q1 Q2 ->
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      subqtype E (qtyp_qtyp Q1 T1) (qtyp_qtyp Q2 T2)
.

Notation "E |-t S <: T" := (sub E S T) (at level 70).

Notation "E |-sqt S <: T" := (subqtype E S T) (at level 70).

Inductive typing : env -> qua -> exp -> qtyp -> Prop :=
  | typing_int : forall E P i,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E P ->
      typing E (qua_base bot) (exp_int P i) (qtyp_qtyp P typ_int)
  | typing_var : forall E x T,
      wf_env E ->
      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
      typing E (qua_base bot) (exp_fvar x) T

  | typing_abs : forall L E P V e1 T1,
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) P (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
      typing E (qua_base bot) (exp_abs P V e1) (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_arrow V T1))

  | typing_app : forall Q T1 E e1 e2 T2,
      typing E Q e1 (qtyp_qtyp Q (typ_arrow T1 T2)) ->
      typing E Q e2 T1 ->
      typing E Q (exp_app e1 e2) T2

  | typing_tabs : forall L E P V e1 T1,
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) P (open_te e1 X) (open_tqt T1 X)) ->
      typing E (qua_base bot) (exp_tabs P V e1) (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_all V T1))

  | typing_tapp : forall Q T1 E e1 T T2,
      typing E Q e1 (qtyp_qtyp Q (typ_all T1 T2)) ->
      sub E T T1 ->
      typing E Q (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tqt T2 T)

  | typing_qabs : forall L E P Q e1 T1,
      wf_qua E P ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_qua Q ++ E) P (open_qe e1 X) (open_qqt T1 X)) ->
      typing E (qua_base bot) (exp_qabs P Q e1) (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_qall Q T1))

  | typing_qapp : forall Q E e1 Q1 T,
      typing E Q e1 (qtyp_qtyp Q (typ_qall Q1 T)) ->
      subqual E Q Q1 ->
      typing E Q (exp_qapp e1 Q) (open_qqt T Q)

  | typing_sub : forall S E Q e T,
      typing E Q e S ->
      subqtype E S T ->
      typing E Q e T

  | typing_subqual : forall E Q R e T,
      typing E Q e T ->
      subqual E Q R ->
      typing E R e T

  | typing_let : forall L T1 T2 e1 e2 E Q,
      typing E Q e1 T1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) Q (open_ee e2 x) T2) ->
      typing E Q (exp_let e1 e2) T2


  | typing_inl : forall T1 T2 P e1 E Q,
      wf_qua E P ->
      typing E Q e1 T1 ->
      wf_qtyp E T2 ->
      typing E Q (exp_inl P e1) (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_sum T1 T2))
  | typing_inr : forall T1 T2 P e1 E Q,
      wf_qua E P ->
      typing E Q e1 T2 ->
      wf_qtyp E T1 ->
      typing E Q (exp_inr P e1) (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_sum T1 T2))
  | typing_case : forall L T1 T2 P T e1 e2 e3 E Q,
      typing E Q e1 (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_sum T1 T2)) ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) Q (open_ee e2 x) T) ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ T2 ++ E) Q (open_ee e3 x) T) ->
      typing E Q (exp_case e1 e2 e3) T
  | typing_pair : forall T1 T2 P e1 e2 E Q,
      wf_qua E P ->
      typing E Q e1 T1 ->
      typing E Q e2 T2 ->
      typing E Q (exp_pair P e1 e2) (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_pair T1 T2))
  | typing_first : forall Q T1 T2 P e E,
      typing E Q e (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_pair T1 T2)) ->
      typing E Q (exp_first e) T1
  | typing_second : forall Q T1 T2 P e E,
      typing E Q e (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_pair T1 T2)) ->
      typing E Q (exp_second e) T2
  | typing_upqual : forall E R Q T P e,
      typing E R e (qtyp_qtyp Q T) ->
      subqual E Q P ->
      typing E R (exp_upqual P e) (qtyp_qtyp P T)
  | typing_check : forall E R Q T P e,
      typing E R e (qtyp_qtyp Q T) ->
      subqual E Q P ->
      typing E R (exp_check P e) (qtyp_qtyp Q T)
  | typing_without : forall E R Q T P e,
      typing E R e (qtyp_qtyp Q T) ->
      subqual E R (qua_negate P) ->
      typing E R (exp_without P e) (qtyp_qtyp Q T)
  | typing_do : forall E b,
      wf_env E ->
      typing E (qua_base b) (exp_do b) (qtyp_qtyp (qua_base bot) typ_int)
  | typing_if0 : forall E R Q e1 e2 e3 T,
      typing E R e1 (qtyp_qtyp Q typ_int) ->
      typing E R e2 T ->
      typing E R e3 T ->
      typing E R (exp_if0 e1 e2 e3) T
.

Notation "E @ Q |-t e : T" := (typing E Q e T) (at level 70).

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | value_int : forall P x,
      qual P ->
      value (exp_int P x)
  | value_abs : forall P T e1,
      expr (exp_abs P T e1) ->
      value (exp_abs P T e1)
  | value_tabs : forall P T e1,
      expr (exp_tabs P T e1) ->
      value (exp_tabs P T e1)
 | value_qabs : forall P Q e1,
      expr (exp_qabs P Q e1) ->
      value (exp_qabs P Q e1)
  | value_inl : forall P e1,
      qual P ->
      value e1 ->
      value (exp_inl P e1)
  | value_inr : forall P e1,
      qual P ->
      value e1 ->
      value (exp_inr P e1)
  | value_pair : forall P e1 e2,
      qual P ->
      value e1 ->
      value e2 ->
      value (exp_pair P e1 e2)
.

Inductive frame : Set :=

  | frame_abs (e : exp) : frame

  | frame_app (f : exp) : frame

  | frame_tabs (T : typ) : frame

  | frame_qabs (R : qua) : frame

  | frame_let (e : exp) : frame

  | frame_inl (P : qua) : frame

  | frame_inr (P : qua) : frame

  | frame_case (e1 : exp) (e2 : exp) : frame

  | frame_pair_1 (P : qua) (e1 : exp) : frame

  | frame_pair_2 (P : qua) (e2 : exp) : frame

  | frame_first : frame

  | frame_second : frame

  | frame_upqual (P : qua) : frame

  | frame_check (P : qua) : frame

  | frame_without : concrete_qua -> frame

  | frame_barrier : concrete_qua -> frame

  | frame_if0 (e1 : exp) (e2: exp) : frame.

Notation ctx := (list frame).

Notation done := (@nil frame).

Inductive typing_ctx : env -> qua -> ctx -> qtyp -> qtyp -> Prop :=

  | typing_ctx_done : forall E Q T,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E Q ->
      wf_qtyp E T ->
      typing_ctx E Q done T T

  | typing_ctx_abs : forall E Q c e1 T1 T2 U,
      typing_ctx E Q c T2 U ->
      typing E Q e1 T1 ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_abs e1 :: c) (qtyp_qtyp Q (typ_arrow T1 T2)) U

  | typing_ctx_app : forall E Q c e1 T1 T2 U,
      typing_ctx E Q c T2 U ->
      value e1 ->
      typing E Q e1 (qtyp_qtyp Q (typ_arrow T1 T2)) ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_app e1 :: c) T1 U

  | typing_ctx_tabs : forall L E Q c T1 T1' T2 U,
      typing_ctx E Q c (open_tqt T2 T1') U ->
      sub E T1' T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          wf_qtyp (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tqt T2 X)) ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_tabs T1' :: c) (qtyp_qtyp Q (typ_all T1 T2)) U
  | typing_ctx_qabs : forall L E Q c R R' T2 U,
      typing_ctx E Q c (open_qqt T2 R') U ->
      subqual E R' R ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          wf_qtyp (X ~ bind_qua R ++ E) (open_qqt T2 X)) ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_qabs R' :: c) (qtyp_qtyp Q (typ_qall R T2)) U

  | typing_ctx_let : forall L E Q c e1 T1 T2 U,
      typing_ctx E Q c T2 U->
      (forall x, x `notin` L -> typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) Q (open_ee e1 x) T2) ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_let e1 :: c) T1 U

  | typing_ctx_inl : forall E P Q c T1 T2 U,
      typing_ctx E Q c (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_sum T1 T2)) U ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_inl P :: c) T1 U
  | typing_ctx_inr : forall E P Q c T1 T2 U,
      typing_ctx E Q c (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_sum T1 T2)) U ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_inr P :: c) T2 U

  | typing_ctx_case : forall L E P Q c T T1 T2 e2 e3 U,
      wf_qua E P ->
      typing_ctx E Q c T U ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) Q (open_ee e2 x) T) ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ T2 ++ E) Q (open_ee e3 x) T) ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_case e2 e3 :: c) (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_sum T1 T2)) U

  | typing_ctx_pair_1 : forall E P Q c e T1 T2 U,
      wf_qua E P ->
      typing_ctx E Q c (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_pair T1 T2)) U ->
      typing E Q e T2 ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_pair_1 P e :: c) T1 U
  | typing_ctx_pair_2 : forall E P Q c v T1 T2 U,
      wf_qua E P ->
      typing_ctx E Q c (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_pair T1 T2)) U ->
      value v ->
      typing E Q v T1 ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_pair_2 P v :: c) T2 U

  | typing_ctx_first : forall E P Q c T1 T2 U,
      wf_qua E P ->
      typing_ctx E Q c T1 U ->
      wf_qtyp E T2 ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_first :: c) (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_pair T1 T2)) U
  | typing_ctx_second : forall E P Q c T1 T2 U,
      wf_qua E P ->
      typing_ctx E Q c T2 U ->
      wf_qtyp E T1 ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_second :: c) (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_pair T1 T2)) U

  | typing_ctx_barrier : forall E Q c s t T U,
      typing_ctx E Q c T U ->
      (concretize Q) = Some s ->
      t ≤ s ->
      typing_ctx E (abstractize t) (frame_barrier t :: c) T U

  | typing_ctx_upqual : forall E Q c P T U,
      typing_ctx E Q c (qtyp_qtyp P T) U ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_upqual P :: c) (qtyp_qtyp P T) U
  | typing_ctx_check :  forall E Q c R P T U,
      wf_qua E R ->
      typing_ctx E Q c (qtyp_qtyp P T) U ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_check R :: c) (qtyp_qtyp (qua_meet P R) T) U

  | typing_ctx_sub : forall E Q c S T U,
      typing_ctx E Q c T U ->
      subqtype E S T ->
      typing_ctx E Q c S U
  | typing_ctx_subqual : forall E Q R c T U,
      typing_ctx E Q c T U ->
      subqual E R Q ->
      typing_ctx E R c T U



  | typing_ctx_without : forall E Q c t T U,
      typing_ctx E Q c T U ->
      typing_ctx E (qua_meet (abstractize (negate t)) Q) (frame_without t :: c) T U

  | typing_ctx_if0 : forall E R c e2 e3 T Q U,
      wf_qua E Q ->
      typing_ctx E R c T U ->
      typing E R e2 T ->
      typing E R e3 T ->
      typing_ctx E R (frame_if0 e2 e3 :: c) (qtyp_qtyp Q typ_int) U
.

Notation "E @ Q |-c c : T ~~> U" := (typing_ctx E Q c T U) (at level 70).

Inductive state : Type :=
  | state_step (e : exp) (c : ctx) : state.

Notation "〈 e | c 〉" := (state_step e c).

Inductive typing_state : env -> state -> qtyp -> Prop :=
  | typing_step : forall E Q e c T U,
    typing E Q e T ->
    typing_ctx E Q c T U ->
    typing_state E 〈 e | c 〉U
.

Notation "E |-s 〈 e | c 〉 : U" := (typing_state E 〈 e | c 〉 U) (at level 70).

Inductive barrier_compatible : ctx -> concrete_qua -> Prop :=
  | barrier_compatible_done : forall s, barrier_compatible done s
  | barrier_compatible_frame : forall c s t,
      barrier_compatible c s ->
      s ≤ t ->
      barrier_compatible (frame_barrier t :: c) s
  | barrier_compatible_without : forall c s t,
      barrier_compatible c s ->
      s ≤ (negate t) ->
      barrier_compatible (frame_without t :: c) s
  | barrier_compatible_other : forall c s f,
      barrier_compatible c s ->
      (forall t, f <> frame_barrier t) ->
      (forall t, f <> frame_without t) ->
      barrier_compatible (f :: c) s
.

Inductive step : state -> state -> Prop :=

  | step_barrier : forall e s k,
      value e ->
      step〈 e | frame_barrier s :: k 〉〈 e | k 〉

  | step_app_1 : forall e1 e2 k,
      step〈 (exp_app e1 e2) | k 〉
        〈 e1 | frame_abs e2 :: k 〉
  | step_app_2 : forall v e2 k,
      value v ->
      step〈 v | frame_abs e2 :: k 〉
        〈 e2 | frame_app v :: k 〉
  | step_tapp : forall e1 T k,
      step〈 (exp_tapp e1 T) | k 〉
        〈 e1 | frame_tabs T :: k 〉
  | step_qapp : forall e1 Q k,
      step〈 (exp_qapp e1 Q) | k 〉
        〈 e1 | frame_qabs Q :: k 〉
  | step_let : forall e1 e2 k,
      step〈 (exp_let e1 e2) | k 〉
        〈 e1 | frame_let e2 :: k 〉
  | step_inl : forall e1 P k,
      step〈 (exp_inl P e1) | k 〉
        〈 e1 | frame_inl P :: k 〉
  | step_inr : forall e1 k P,
      step〈 (exp_inr P e1) | k 〉
        〈 e1 | frame_inr P :: k 〉
  | step_case : forall e1 e2 e3 k,
      step〈 (exp_case e1 e2 e3) | k 〉
        〈 e1 | frame_case e2 e3 :: k 〉
  | step_pair_1 : forall P e1 e2 k,
      step〈 (exp_pair P e1 e2) | k 〉
        〈 e1 | frame_pair_1 P e2 :: k 〉
  | step_pair_2 : forall P v e2 k,
      value v ->
      step〈 v | frame_pair_1 P e2 :: k 〉
        〈 e2 | frame_pair_2 P v :: k 〉
  | step_first : forall e1 k,
      step〈 (exp_first e1) | k 〉
        〈 e1 | frame_first :: k 〉
  | step_second : forall e1 k,
      step〈 (exp_second e1) | k 〉
        〈 e1 | frame_second :: k 〉


  | step_app_abs : forall Q V e1 e2 t k,
      value e2 ->
      concretize Q = Some t ->
      barrier_compatible k t ->
      step〈 e2 | frame_app (exp_abs Q V e1) :: k 〉
        〈 (open_ee e1 e2) | frame_barrier t :: k 〉
  | step_app_tabs : forall P T e1 V t k,
      type V ->
      concretize P = Some t ->
      barrier_compatible k t ->
      step〈 (exp_tabs P T e1) | frame_tabs V :: k 〉
        〈 (open_te e1 V) | frame_barrier t :: k 〉
  | step_app_qabs : forall P Q e1 R t k,
      qual R ->
      concretize P = Some t ->
      barrier_compatible k t ->
      step〈 (exp_qabs P Q e1) | frame_qabs R :: k 〉
        〈 (open_qe e1 R) | frame_barrier t :: k 〉
  | step_let_value : forall v1 e2 k,
      value v1 ->
      step〈 v1 | frame_let e2 :: k 〉
        〈 (open_ee e2 v1) | k 〉
  | step_case_inl : forall P v1 e2 e3 k,
      value v1 ->
      step〈 (exp_inl P v1) | frame_case e2 e3 :: k 〉
        〈 (open_ee e2 v1) | k 〉
  | step_case_inr : forall P v1 e2 e3 k,
      value v1 ->
      step〈 (exp_inr P v1) | frame_case e2 e3 :: k 〉
        〈 (open_ee e3 v1) | k 〉
  | step_first_pair : forall P v1 v2 k,
      value v1 ->
      value v2 ->
      step〈 (exp_pair P v1 v2) | frame_first :: k 〉
        〈 v1 | k 〉
  | step_second_pair : forall P v1 v2 k,
      value v1 ->
      value v2 ->
      step〈 (exp_pair P v1 v2) | frame_second :: k 〉
        〈 v2 | k 〉
  | step_make_inl : forall P v1 k,
      value v1 ->
        step〈 v1 | frame_inl P :: k 〉
            〈 (exp_inl P v1) | k 〉
  | step_make_inr : forall P v1 k,
      value v1 ->
        step〈 v1 | frame_inr P :: k 〉
            〈 (exp_inr P v1) | k 〉
  | step_make_pair : forall P v1 v2 k,
      value v2 ->
      value v1 ->
            step〈 v2 | frame_pair_2 P v1 :: k 〉
                〈 (exp_pair P v1 v2) | k 〉

  | step_upqual_1 : forall P e1 k,
      step 〈 (exp_upqual P e1) | k 〉
      〈 e1 | (frame_upqual P :: k) 〉
  | step_upqual_int : forall P Q cP cQ z k,
      concretize P = Some cP ->
      concretize Q = Some cQ ->
      cQ ≤ cP ->
      step 〈 (exp_int Q z) | frame_upqual P :: k 〉
      〈 (exp_int P z) | k 〉
  | step_upqual_abs : forall P Q cP cQ V e1 k,
      concretize P = Some cP ->
      concretize Q = Some cQ ->
      cQ ≤ cP ->

Require Export Fsub.EffectExclusion.Fsub_LetSum_Definitions.

Fixpoint fv_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_int => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fv_tqt T1) `union` (fv_tqt T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tqt T2)
  | typ_qall Q T  => (fv_tqt T)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => (fv_tqt T1) `union` (fv_tqt T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => (fv_tqt T1) `union` (fv_tqt T2)
  | typ_ref T1 => (fv_tqt T1)
  end
with fv_tqt (T : qtyp) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T => (fv_tt T)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_te (e : exp) {struct e} : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_int P i => {}
  | exp_bvar i => {}
  | exp_fvar x => {}
  | exp_abs P V e1  => (fv_tqt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_qabs P V e1 => (fv_te e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 V => (fv_te e1)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => (fv_te e1)
  | exp_inr P e1 => (fv_te e1)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2) `union` (fv_te e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
  | exp_first e1 => (fv_te e1)
  | exp_second e1 => (fv_te e1)
  | exp_ref P e1 => (fv_te e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => {}
  | exp_deref e1 => (fv_te e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => (fv_te e1)
  | exp_check P e1 => (fv_te e1)
  | exp_without P e1 => (fv_te e1)
  | exp_do b => {}
  | exp_if0 e1 e2 e3 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2) `union` (fv_te e3)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_qq (Q : qua) {struct Q} : atoms :=
  match Q with
  | qua_base b => {}
  | qua_bvar i => {}
  | qua_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 => fv_qq Q1 `union` fv_qq Q2
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 => fv_qq Q1 `union` fv_qq Q2
  | qua_negate Q1 => fv_qq Q1
  end.

Fixpoint fv_qt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_int => {}
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fv_qqt T1) `union` (fv_qqt T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fv_qt T1) `union` (fv_qqt T2)
  | typ_qall Q T  => (fv_qq Q) `union` (fv_qqt T)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => (fv_qqt T1) `union` (fv_qqt T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => (fv_qqt T1) `union` (fv_qqt T2)
  | typ_ref T1 => fv_qqt T1
  end
with fv_qqt (T : qtyp) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T => (fv_qq Q) `union` (fv_qt T)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_qe (e : exp) {struct e} : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_int P i => fv_qq P
  | exp_bvar i => {}
  | exp_fvar x => {}
  | exp_abs P V e1  => (fv_qq P) `union` (fv_qqt V) `union` (fv_qe e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => (fv_qe e1) `union` (fv_qe e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => (fv_qq P) `union` (fv_qt V) `union` (fv_qe e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => (fv_qt V) `union` (fv_qe e1)
  | exp_qabs P V e1 => (fv_qq P) `union` (fv_qe e1) `union` (fv_qq V)
  | exp_qapp e1 V => (fv_qe e1) `union` (fv_qq V)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => (fv_qe e1) `union` (fv_qe e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => (fv_qq P) `union` (fv_qe e1)
  | exp_inr P e1 => (fv_qq P) `union` (fv_qe e1)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 => (fv_qe e1) `union` (fv_qe e2) `union` (fv_qe e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => (fv_qq P) `union` (fv_qe e1) `union` (fv_qe e2)
  | exp_first e1 => (fv_qe e1)
  | exp_second e1 => (fv_qe e1)
  | exp_ref P e1 => (fv_qq P) `union` (fv_qe e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => (fv_qq P)
  | exp_deref e1 => (fv_qe e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => (fv_qe e1) `union` (fv_qe e2)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => (fv_qq P) `union` (fv_qe e1)
  | exp_check P e1 => (fv_qq P) `union` (fv_qe e1)
  | exp_without P e1 => (fv_qq P) `union` (fv_qe e1)
  | exp_do b => {}
  | exp_if0 e1 e2 e3 => (fv_qe e1) `union` (fv_qe e2) `union` (fv_qe e3)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_ee (e : exp) {struct e} : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_int P i => {}
  | exp_bvar i => {}
  | exp_fvar x => {{ x }}
  | exp_abs P V e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_qabs P V e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 V => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_inr P e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2) `union` (fv_ee e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2)
  | exp_first e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_second e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_ref P e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => {}
  | exp_deref e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_check P e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_without P e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_do b => {}
  | exp_if0 e1 e2 e3 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2) `union` (fv_ee e3)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_tt (Z : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_int => typ_int
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then U else T
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tqt Z U T1) (subst_tqt Z U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tqt Z U T2)
  | typ_qall Q T => typ_qall Q (subst_tqt Z U T)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => typ_sum (subst_tqt Z U T1) (subst_tqt Z U T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => typ_pair (subst_tqt Z U T1) (subst_tqt Z U T2)
  | typ_ref T1 => typ_ref (subst_tqt Z U T1)
  end
with subst_tqt (Z : atom) (U : typ) (T : qtyp) {struct T} : qtyp :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T => qtyp_qtyp Q (subst_tt Z U T)
  end
  .

Fixpoint subst_qq (Z : atom) (U : qua) (T : qua) {struct T} : qua :=
  match T with
  | qua_base b => qua_base b
  | qua_bvar J => qua_bvar J
  | qua_fvar X => if X == Z then U else T
  | qua_meet T1 T2 => qua_meet (subst_qq Z U T1) (subst_qq Z U T2)
  | qua_join T1 T2 => qua_join (subst_qq Z U T1) (subst_qq Z U T2)
  | qua_negate T1 => qua_negate (subst_qq Z U T1)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_qt (Z : atom) (U : qua) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_int => typ_int
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_qqt Z U T1) (subst_qqt Z U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (subst_qt Z U T1) (subst_qqt Z U T2)
  | typ_qall Q T => typ_qall (subst_qq Z U Q) (subst_qqt Z U T)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => typ_sum (subst_qqt Z U T1) (subst_qqt Z U T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => typ_pair (subst_qqt Z U T1) (subst_qqt Z U T2)
  | typ_ref T1 => typ_ref (subst_qqt Z U T1)
  end
with subst_qqt (Z : atom) (U : qua) (T : qtyp) {struct T} : qtyp :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T => qtyp_qtyp (subst_qq Z U Q) (subst_qt Z U T)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_qe (Z : atom) (U : qua) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_int P i => exp_int (subst_qq Z U P) i
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs (subst_qq Z U P) (subst_qqt Z U V)  (subst_qe Z U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (subst_qe Z U e1) (subst_qe Z U e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs (subst_qq Z U P) (subst_qt Z U V)  (subst_qe Z U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_qe Z U e1) (subst_qt Z U V)
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs (subst_qq Z U P) (subst_qq Z U Q)  (subst_qe Z U e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (subst_qe Z U e1) (subst_qq Z U Q)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (subst_qe Z U e1) (subst_qe Z U e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl (subst_qq Z U P) (subst_qe Z U e1)
  | exp_inr P e1 => exp_inr (subst_qq Z U P) (subst_qe Z U e1)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 => exp_case (subst_qe Z U e1)
                                  (subst_qe Z U e2) (subst_qe Z U e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair (subst_qq Z U P) (subst_qe Z U e1) (subst_qe Z U e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (subst_qe Z U e1)
  | exp_second e1 => exp_second (subst_qe Z U e1)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref (subst_qq Z U P) (subst_qe Z U e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label  (subst_qq Z U P) l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (subst_qe Z U e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (subst_qe Z U e1) (subst_qe Z U e2)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual (subst_qq Z U P) (subst_qe Z U e1)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check (subst_qq Z U P) (subst_qe Z U e1)
  | exp_without P e1 => exp_without (subst_qq Z U P) (subst_qe Z U e1)
  | exp_do b => exp_do b
  | exp_if0 e1 e2 e3 => exp_if0 (subst_qe Z U e1)
                                  (subst_qe Z U e2) (subst_qe Z U e3)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_te (Z : atom) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_int P i => exp_int P i
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs P (subst_tqt Z U V)  (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_te Z U e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs P (subst_tt Z U V)  (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_tt Z U V)
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs P Q (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (subst_te Z U e1) Q
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_te Z U e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl P (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_inr P e1 => exp_inr P (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 => exp_case (subst_te Z U e1)
                                  (subst_te Z U e2) (subst_te Z U e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair P (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_te Z U e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_second e1 => exp_second (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref P (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label P l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_te Z U e2)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual P (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check P (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_without P e1 => exp_without P (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_do b => exp_do b
  | exp_if0 e1 e2 e3 => exp_if0 (subst_te Z U e1)
                                  (subst_te Z U e2) (subst_te Z U e3)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_ee (z : atom) (u : exp) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_int P i => exp_int P i
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => if x == z then u else e
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs P V (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs P V (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_ee z u e1) V
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs P Q (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (subst_ee z u e1) Q
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl P (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_inr P e1 => exp_inr P (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 => exp_case (subst_ee z u e1)
                                  (subst_ee z u e2) (subst_ee z u e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair P (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_second e1 => exp_second (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref P (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label P l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual P (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check P (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_without P e1 => exp_without P (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_do b => exp_do b
  | exp_if0 e1 e2 e3 => exp_if0 (subst_ee z u e1)
                                  (subst_ee z u e2) (subst_ee z u e3)
  end.

Definition subst_tb (Z : atom) (P : typ) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (subst_tt Z P T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (subst_tqt Z P T)
  | bind_qua Q => bind_qua Q
  end.

Definition subst_qb (Z : atom) (P : qua) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (subst_qt Z P T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (subst_qqt Z P T)
  | bind_qua Q => bind_qua (subst_qq Z P Q)
  end.

Given the magnitude, maybe we should consider a completely different, "semantic" proof strategy that avoids full substitution metatheory? Preservation and progress are syntax-directed; there's no way around substitution for app/let/case/tabs/qabs. But perhaps we can exploit the specific form: after substitution, we need to type `open_ee e1 e2` where e2 is a value. We need a substitution lemma. Similarly type/qual substitution. So at minimum: three substitution lemmas (ee with value, te, qe), plus weakening and wf/fv lemmas.

Progress needs canonical forms: given typing_state E empty s U and not done, find step. Actually progress target: typing_state empty s U -> done_state s \/ exists s', step. `empty` is empty env = nil. So E = empty. That simplifies: wf_env empty. State `〈 e | c 〉`. If c = done ([]), need show value e from typing empty Q e T, then done. If c = f :: k, need exhibit a step based on shape of e and f. Need inversion of typing for e to know shape (expr rules) and value canonicity.

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
    wf_env_empty : wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
                 wf_env E ->
                 wf_typ E T ->
                 X `notin` dom E -> wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : qtyp),
                 wf_env E ->
                 wf_qtyp E T ->
                 x `notin` dom E -> wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E)
  | wf_env_qua : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (Q : qua),
                 wf_env E ->
                 wf_qua E Q ->
                 X `notin` dom E -> wf_env (X ~ bind_qua Q ++ E).

Arguments wf_env _%_list_scope
Arguments wf_env_sub E%_list_scope X T _ _ _
Arguments wf_env_typ E%_list_scope x T _ _ _
Arguments wf_env_qua E%_list_scope X Q _ _ _
Notation "~ x" := (not x) (* x in scope _type_scope *) : type_scope
  (default interpretation) (from Corelib.Init.Logic)
Notation "x ~ a" := (one (pair x a)) : list_scope (default interpretation)
  (from Fsub.FbMeta.AssocList.Make)
Notation "p ~ 1" := (xI p) (* p in scope _positive_scope *) : positive_scope
  (from Corelib.BinNums.PosDef)
Notation "p ~ 0" := (xO p) (* p in scope _positive_scope *) : positive_scope
  (from Corelib.BinNums.PosDef)
Notation "x ++ y" := (app x y)
  (* x in scope _list_scope, y in scope _list_scope *) : list_scope
  (default interpretation) (from Corelib.Init.Datatypes)

  (* s1 in scope _string_scope, s2 in scope _string_scope *) : string_scope
  (from Stdlib.Strings.String)
dom =
fix dom (C : Type) (E : list (atom * C)) {struct E} : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => Metatheory.empty
  | (x, _) :: E' => add x (dom C E')
  end
     : forall [C : Type], list (atom * C) -> atoms

meet_is_glb =
fun (A : Set) (O : Order A) (L : Lattice A) (H : LOSet O L) (a b x : A) =>
conj
  (fun H0 : x ≤ a /\ x ≤ b =>
   and_ind
     (fun (H1 : x ≤ a) (H2 : x ≤ b) =>
      let H3 : forall a0 b0 : A, a0 ≤ b0 -> a0 = a0 ⊓ b0 :=
        fun a0 b0 : A =>
        match meet_consistent a0 b0 with
        | conj x0 _ => x0
        end in
      let H4 : x = x ⊓ a := H3 x a H1 in
      let H5 : forall a0 b0 : A, a0 ≤ b0 -> a0 = a0 ⊓ b0 :=
        fun a0 b0 : A =>
        match meet_consistent a0 b0 with
        | conj x0 _ => x0
        end in
      let H6 : x = x ⊓ b := H5 x b H2 in
      let H7 : forall a0 b0 : A, a0 = a0 ⊓ b0 -> a0 ≤ b0 :=
        fun a0 b0 : A =>
        match meet_consistent a0 b0 with
        | conj _ x1 => x1

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Export Fsub.EffectExclusion.Fsub_LetSum_Lemmas.

(* ========================================================= *)
(* Environment extension relation                             *)
(* ========================================================= *)

Definition extends (E E' : env) : Prop :=
  forall x b, binds x b E -> binds x b E'.

Lemma extends_refl : forall E, extends E E.
Proof. intros E x b H; auto. Qed.

Lemma extends_trans : forall E1 E2 E3,
  extends E1 E2 -> extends E2 E3 -> extends E1 E3.
Proof. intros E1 E2 E3 H12 H23 x b H; auto. Qed.

Lemma extends_cons : forall E x b,
  extends E ((x,b) :: E).
Proof.
  intros E x b y c H. apply binds_app_3. simpl. apply H.
Qed.

Lemma extends_cons_same : forall E E' x b,
  extends E E' -> extends ((x,b)::E) ((x,b)::E').
Proof.
  intros E E' x b H y c Hy.
  apply binds_cons_1 in Hy as [[? ?]|Hy]; subst; auto.
  left; auto.
  right; apply H; auto.
Qed.

Lemma extends_app_l : forall E F, extends E (F ++ E).
Proof. intros E F x b H. apply binds_app_3. auto. Qed.

(* wf_env basic facts                                         *)
(* ========================================================= *)

Lemma wf_env_cons_inv : forall x b E,
  wf_env ((x,b)::E) -> wf_env E.
Proof. intros x b E H; inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_sub_inv : forall X T E,
  wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E) ->
  wf_env E /\ wf_typ E T /\ X `notin` dom E.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

  wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E) ->
  wf_env E /\ wf_qtyp E T /\ x `notin` dom E.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_qua_inv : forall X Q E,
  wf_env (X ~ bind_qua Q ++ E) ->
  wf_env E /\ wf_qua E Q /\ X `notin` dom E.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Proof.

  - constructor.
  - apply uniq_cons; auto.
  - apply uniq_cons; auto.
  - apply uniq_cons; auto.

Require Import Fsub.EffectExclusion.Tactics.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Export Fsub.EffectExclusion.Fsub_LetSum_Lemmas.

(* ========================================================= *)
(* Environment extension relation                             *)
(* ========================================================= *)

Definition extends (E E' : env) : Prop :=
  forall x b, binds x b E -> binds x b E'.

Lemma extends_refl : forall E, extends E E.
Proof. intros E x b H; auto. Qed.

Lemma extends_trans : forall E1 E2 E3,
  extends E1 E2 -> extends E2 E3 -> extends E1 E3.
Proof. intros E1 E2 E3 H12 H23 x b H; auto. Qed.

Lemma extends_cons : forall E x b,
  extends E ((x,b) :: E).
Proof. intros E x b y c H. apply binds_cons. auto. Qed.

Lemma extends_cons_same : forall E E' x b,
  extends E E' -> extends ((x,b)::E) ((x,b)::E').
Proof.
  intros E E' x b H y c Hy.
  apply binds_cons_1 in Hy as [[? ?]|Hy]; subst; auto.
  left; auto.
  right; apply H; auto.
Qed.

Lemma extends_app_l : forall E F, extends E (F ++ E).
Proof. intros E F x b H. apply binds_app_3. auto. Qed.

Lemma binds_mid_weaken : forall (A : Type) (y : atom) (c : A) E1 x b E2,
  binds y c (E1 ++ E2) -> binds y c (E1 ++ x ~ b ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros A y c E1 x b E2 H. unfold binds in *.
  rewrite app_assoc.
  apply in_app_iff. apply in_app_iff in H as [H|H].
  - left; auto.
  - right. apply in_app_iff. right; auto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_remove_mid : forall E1 x b E2 y,
  y `notin` dom (E1 ++ x ~ b ++ E2) -> y `notin` dom (E1 ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros E1 x b E2 y H Hy.
  apply binds_In_inv in Hy as [c Hc].
  apply binds_In in (binds_mid_weaken _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hc) as Hc'.
  contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_cons_tail : forall x b E y,
  y `notin` dom ((x,b)::E) -> y `notin` dom E.
Proof. intros. simpl in *. apply notin_add_2 in H. auto. Qed.

(* ========================================================= *)
(* wf_env basic facts                                         *)
(* ========================================================= *)

Lemma wf_env_cons_inv : forall x b E,
  wf_env ((x,b)::E) -> wf_env E.
Proof. intros x b E H; inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_sub_inv : forall X T E,
  wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E) ->
  wf_env E /\ wf_typ E T /\ X `notin` dom E.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_typ_inv : forall x T E,
  wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E) ->
  wf_env E /\ wf_qtyp E T /\ x `notin` dom E.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_qua_inv : forall X Q E,
  wf_env (X ~ bind_qua Q ++ E) ->
  wf_env E /\ wf_qua E Q /\ X `notin` dom E.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  induction 1; simpl.
  - constructor.
  - apply uniq_cons; auto.
  - apply uniq_cons; auto.
  - apply uniq_cons; auto.
Qed.

(* removal of a middle bind_typ from wf_env *)
Lemma wf_env_remove_typ_mid : forall E1 x T E2,
  wf_env (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ T ++ E2) -> wf_env (E1 ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros E1. induction E1 as [| y c E1 IH]; intros x T E2 H.
  - simpl in *. apply wf_env_cons_inv in H. auto.
  - simpl in *.
    inversion H; subst.
    + apply IH in H2.

      eapply notin_dom_remove_mid; eauto.
    + apply IH in H2.
      eapply wf_env_typ; eauto.
      eapply notin_dom_remove_mid; eauto.
    + apply IH in H2.
      eapply wf_env_qua; eauto.
      eapply notin_dom_remove_mid; eauto.
Qed.

(* wf_env weakening: insert arbitrary binding in middle *)
Lemma wf_env_mid_weaken : forall E1 E2 x b,
  wf_env (E1 ++ E2) ->
  wf_typ (E1 ++ E2) typ_top ->  (* placeholder unused *)
  True.
Proof. auto. Qed.
EOF

  forall Q, wf_qua E Q -> wf_qua E' Q.
Proof.
  intros E E' Hext Q H. induction H.
  - constructor.

  - constructor; auto.

  (forall (E:env) (T:qtyp), wf_qtyp E T ->
     forall E', extends E E' -> wf_qtyp E' T).
Proof.
  apply wf_tq_mut
    with (P := fun E T _ => forall E', extends E E' -> wf_typ E' T)
         (P0 := fun E T _ => forall E', extends E E' -> wf_qtyp E' T).

  - intros E E' He. constructor.

  - intros E T1 T2 w1 IH1 w2 IH2 E' He. constructor; auto.

  - intros L E T1 T2 wq w0 IH0 E' He.

  - intros E T1 T2 w1 IH1 w2 IH2 E' He. constructor; auto.
  - intros E T1 T2 w1 IH1 w2 IH2 E' He. constructor; auto.
  - intros E Q T wq wT IHT E' He. apply wf_qtyp_qtyp.

Lemma sub_subqtype_wf :
  (forall (E:env) (S T:typ), sub E S T ->
     wf_env E /\ wf_typ E S /\ wf_typ E T) /\
  (forall (E:env) (S T:qtyp), subqtype E S T ->
     wf_env E /\ wf_qtyp E S /\ wf_qtyp E T).
Proof.
  apply sub_tq_mut
    with (P := fun E S T _ => wf_env E /\ wf_typ E S /\ wf_typ E T)
         (P0 := fun E S T _ => wf_env E /\ wf_qtyp E S /\ wf_qtyp E T).
  - intros E S w w0. repeat split; auto. constructor.
  - intros E w. repeat split; auto. constructor.
  - intros E X w w0. repeat split; auto.

    repeat split; auto. apply wf_typ_var. exact b.
  - intros E S1 S2 T1 T2 s IH1 s0 IH2.
    destruct IH1 as [He [HS1' HS1]]. destruct IH2 as [_ [HS2 HT2]].
    repeat split; auto. apply wf_typ_arrow; auto.
  - intros L E S1 S2 T1 T2 s IH1 s0 IH0.
    destruct IH1 as [He [HT1 HS1]].

    + auto.

      eapply wf_qtyp_bind_sub_irrel; eauto.
  - intros L E S1 S2 T1 T2 s s0 IH0.

    apply wf_typ_qall with (L:=L).

      eapply wf_qtyp_bind_qua_irrel; eauto.
  - intros E S1 S2 T1 T2 s IH1 s0 IH2.
    destruct IH1 as [He [HS1 HT1]]. destruct IH2 as [_ [HS2 HT2]].
    repeat split; auto. apply wf_typ_sum; auto.
  - intros E S1 S2 T1 T2 s IH1 s0 IH2.
    destruct IH1 as [He [HS1 HT1]]. destruct IH2 as [_ [HS2 HT2]].
    repeat split; auto. apply wf_typ_pair; auto.

    destruct IH as [_ [HT1 HT2]].
    repeat split; auto.
    + apply wf_qtyp_qtyp; auto.
    + apply wf_qtyp_qtyp; auto.
Qed.

  wf_env E /\ wf_typ E S /\ wf_typ E T.

(* locally-closed (with depth) for type bvars and qualifier bvars *)
Fixpoint lc_tt (T:typ) (d:nat) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_int => True
  | typ_bvar n => n < d
  | typ_fvar _ => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => lc_tqt T1 d /\ lc_tqt T2 d
  | typ_all T1 T2 => lc_tt T1 d /\ lc_tqt T2 (S d)
  | typ_qall Q T => lc_tqt T d
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => lc_tqt T1 d /\ lc_tqt T2 d
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => lc_tqt T1 d /\ lc_tqt T2 d
  | typ_ref T1 => lc_tqt T1 d
  end
with lc_tqt (T:qtyp) (d:nat) : Prop :=
  match T with qtyp_qtyp Q T' => lc_tt T' d end.

Fixpoint lc_qq (Q:qua) (d:nat) : Prop :=
  match Q with
  | qua_base _ => True
  | qua_bvar n => n < d
  | qua_fvar _ => True
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 => lc_qq Q1 d /\ lc_qq Q2 d
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 => lc_qq Q1 d /\ lc_qq Q2 d
  | qua_negate Q1 => lc_qq Q1 d
  end.

Fixpoint lc_qqt (T:qtyp) (d:nat) : Prop :=
  match T with qtyp_qtyp Q T' => lc_qq Q d /\ lc_tt_q T' d end
with lc_tt_q (T:typ) (d:nat) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True | typ_int => True | typ_bvar _ => True | typ_fvar _ => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => lc_qqt T1 d /\ lc_qqt T2 d
  | typ_all T1 T2 => lc_tt_q T1 d /\ lc_qqt T2 (S d)
  | typ_qall Q T => lc_qq Q d /\ lc_qqt T (S d)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => lc_qqt T1 d /\ lc_qqt T2 d
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => lc_qqt T1 d /\ lc_qqt T2 d
  | typ_ref T1 => lc_qqt T1 d
  end.
EOF

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_int => typ_int
  | typ_bvar J => if K == J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_qall Q T => typ_qall Q (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => typ_sum (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => typ_pair (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_ref T1 => typ_ref (open_tqt_rec K U T1)
  end
with open_tqt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : qtyp)  {struct T} : qtyp :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T => qtyp_qtyp Q (open_tt_rec K U T)

    end
  | qua_negate Q1 =>
    match (concretize Q1) with
    | Some b1 => Some (negate b1)
    | None => None
    end
  end.

(* monotonicity of locally-closed bounds *)
Fixpoint lc_tt_mono (T:typ) {struct T} :
  forall d, lc_tt T d -> lc_tt T (S d)
with lc_tqt_mono (T:qtyp) {struct T} :
  forall d, lc_tqt T d -> lc_tqt T (S d).
Proof.
  - destruct T; intros d H; simpl in *; try exact I.
    + lia.
    + split; [apply (lc_tqt_mono _ d)|apply (lc_tqt_mono _ (S d))]; [exact (proj1 H)|exact (proj2 H)].
    + split; [apply (lc_tt_mono _ d)|apply (lc_tqt_mono _ (S d))]; [exact (proj1 H)|exact (proj2 H)].
    + apply (lc_tqt_mono _ (S d)). exact H.
    + split; [apply (lc_tqt_mono _ d)|apply (lc_tqt_mono _ d)]; [exact (proj1 H)|exact (proj2 H)].
    + split; [apply (lc_tqt_mono _ d)|apply (lc_tqt_mono _ d)]; [exact (proj1 H)|exact (proj2 H)].
    + apply (lc_tqt_mono _ d). exact H.
  - destruct T as [Q T]. intros d H. simpl in *. apply (lc_tt_mono _ d). exact H.
Qed.

Fixpoint lc_qq_mono (Q:qua) {struct Q} :
  forall d, lc_qq Q d -> lc_qq Q (S d).
Proof.
  destruct Q; intros d H; simpl in *; try exact I.
  - lia.
  - split; [apply (lc_qq_mono _ d)|apply (lc_qq_mono _ d)]; [exact (proj1 H)|exact (proj2 H)].
  - split; [apply (lc_qq_mono _ d)|apply (lc_qq_mono _ d)]; [exact (proj1 H)|exact (proj2 H)].
  - apply (lc_qq_mono _ d). exact H.
Qed.

Fixpoint lc_qt_mono (T:typ) {struct T} :
  forall d, lc_tt_q T d -> lc_tt_q T (S d)
with lc_qqt_mono (T:qtyp) {struct T} :
  forall d, lc_qqt T d -> lc_qqt T (S d).

    + split; [apply (lc_qt_mono _ d)|apply (lc_qqt_mono _ (S d))]; [exact (proj1 H)|exact (proj2 H)].
    + split; [apply (lc_qq_mono _ d)|apply (lc_qqt_mono _ (S d))]; [exact (proj1 H)|exact (proj2 H)].

Require Import Fsub.EffectExclusion.Tactics.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Export Fsub.EffectExclusion.Fsub_LetSum_Lemmas.
Require Import Lia.

(* ========================================================= *)
(* Environment extension relation                             *)
(* ========================================================= *)

Definition extends (E E' : env) : Prop :=
  forall x b, binds x b E -> binds x b E'.

Lemma extends_refl : forall E, extends E E.
Proof. intros E x b H; auto. Qed.

Lemma extends_trans : forall E1 E2 E3,
  extends E1 E2 -> extends E2 E3 -> extends E1 E3.
Proof. intros E1 E2 E3 H12 H23 x b H; auto. Qed.

Lemma extends_cons : forall E x b,
  extends E ((x,b) :: E).
Proof. intros E x b y c H. apply binds_cons. auto. Qed.

Lemma extends_cons_same : forall E E' x b,
  extends E E' -> extends ((x,b)::E) ((x,b)::E').
Proof.
  intros E E' x b H y c Hy.
  apply binds_cons_1 in Hy as [[? ?]|Hy]; subst.
  - left; auto.
  - right; apply H; auto.
Qed.

Lemma extends_app_l : forall E F, extends E (F ++ E).
Proof. intros E F x b H. apply binds_app_3. auto. Qed.

Lemma binds_mid_weaken : forall (A : Type) (y : atom) (c : A) E1 x b E2,
  binds y c (E1 ++ E2) -> binds y c (E1 ++ x ~ b ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros A y c E1 x b E2 H. unfold binds in *.
  apply in_app_iff.
  apply in_app_iff in H. destruct H as [H|H].
  - left; auto.
  - right. right; auto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_remove_mid : forall (E1:env) x (b:binding) (E2:env) y,
  y `notin` dom (E1 ++ x ~ b ++ E2) -> y `notin` dom (E1 ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros E1 x b E2 y H Hy.
  apply binds_In_inv in Hy as [c Hc].
  apply H. apply (binds_In _ y c). eapply binds_mid_weaken; eauto.
Qed.

(* ========================================================= *)
(* wf_env basic facts                                         *)
(* ========================================================= *)

Lemma wf_env_cons_inv : forall x (b:binding) (E:env),
  wf_env ((x,b)::E) -> wf_env E.
Proof. intros x b E H; inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_sub_inv : forall (X:atom) (T:typ) (E:env),
  wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E) ->
  wf_env E /\ wf_typ E T /\ X `notin` dom E.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_typ_inv : forall (x:atom) (T:qtyp) (E:env),
  wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E) ->
  wf_env E /\ wf_qtyp E T /\ x `notin` dom E.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_qua_inv : forall (X:atom) (Q:qua) (E:env),
  wf_env (X ~ bind_qua Q ++ E) ->
  wf_env E /\ wf_qua E Q /\ X `notin` dom E.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  induction 1; simpl.
  - constructor.
  - apply uniq_cons; auto.
  - apply uniq_cons; auto.
  - apply uniq_cons; auto.
Qed.

(* ========================================================= *)
(* Removing a middle bind_typ from well-formedness            *)
(* ========================================================= *)

Lemma binds_qua_remove_typ_mid : forall (E1:env) x (T:qtyp) (E2:env) z R,
  binds z (bind_qua R) (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ T ++ E2) ->
  binds z (bind_qua R) (E1 ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros E1 x T E2 z R H. unfold binds in *.
  apply in_app_iff.
  apply in_app_iff in H. destruct H as [H|H].
  - left; auto.
  - simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq|H].
    + inversion Heq; subst; discriminate.
    + right; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_sub_remove_typ_mid : forall (E1:env) x (T:qtyp) (E2:env) z U,
  binds z (bind_sub U) (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ T ++ E2) ->
  binds z (bind_sub U) (E1 ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros E1 x T E2 z U H. unfold binds in *.
  apply in_app_iff.
  apply in_app_iff in H. destruct H as [H|H].
  - left; auto.
  - simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq|H].
    + inversion Heq; subst; discriminate.
    + right; auto.
Qed.

Fixpoint wf_qua_remove_typ_mid (Q:qua) {struct Q} :
  forall (E1:env) x (T:qtyp) (E2:env),
  wf_qua (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ T ++ E2) Q -> wf_qua (E1 ++ E2) Q.
Proof.
  destruct Q as [b|n|X|Q1 Q2|Q1 Q2|Q1]; intros E1 x T E2 H.
  - apply wf_qua_base.
  - inversion H.
  - inversion H; subst. eapply wf_qua_fvar. eapply binds_qua_remove_typ_mid; eauto.
  - inversion H; subst. apply wf_qua_meet.
    + apply (wf_qua_remove_typ_mid Q1 E1 x T E2); eassumption.
    + apply (wf_qua_remove_typ_mid Q2 E1 x T E2); eassumption.
  - inversion H; subst. apply wf_qua_join.
    + apply (wf_qua_remove_typ_mid Q1 E1 x T E2); eassumption.
    + apply (wf_qua_remove_typ_mid Q2 E1 x T E2); eassumption.
  - inversion H; subst. apply wf_qua_negate.
    apply (wf_qua_remove_typ_mid Q1 E1 x T E2); eassumption.
Qed.

Scheme wf_t_mut := Induction for wf_typ Sort Prop
with wf_q_mut := Induction for wf_qtyp Sort Prop.
Combined Scheme wf_tq_mut from wf_t_mut, wf_q_mut.

Lemma wf_typ_qtyp_remove_typ_mid :
  (forall (E:env) (T:typ), wf_typ E T ->
     forall (E1:env) x (TT:qtyp) (E2:env),
       E = E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ TT ++ E2 -> wf_typ (E1 ++ E2) T) /\
  (forall (E:env) (T:qtyp), wf_qtyp E T ->
     forall (E1:env) x (TT:qtyp) (E2:env),
       E = E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ TT ++ E2 -> wf_qtyp (E1 ++ E2) T).
Proof.
  apply wf_tq_mut
    with (P := fun E T _ => forall (E1:env) x (TT:qtyp) (E2:env),
                E = E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ TT ++ E2 -> wf_typ (E1 ++ E2) T)
         (P0 := fun E T _ => forall (E1:env) x (TT:qtyp) (E2:env),
                E = E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ TT ++ E2 -> wf_qtyp (E1 ++ E2) T).
  - intros E E1 x TT E2 Heq. subst. constructor.
  - intros E E1 x TT E2 Heq. subst. constructor.
  - intros U E X b E1 x TT E2 Heq. subst.
    apply wf_typ_var with (U:=U).
    apply (binds_sub_remove_typ_mid E1 x TT E2 X U). exact b.
  - intros E T1 T2 w1 IH1 w2 IH2 E1 x TT E2 Heq. subst.
    apply wf_typ_arrow.
    + apply (IH1 E1 x TT E2). reflexivity.
    + apply (IH2 E1 x TT E2). reflexivity.
  - intros L E T1 T2 w1 IH1 w0 IH0 E1 x TT E2 Heq. subst.
    apply wf_typ_all with (L:=L).
    + apply (IH1 E1 x TT E2). reflexivity.
    + intros X HX.
      apply (IH0 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E1) x TT E2).
      rewrite app_assoc. reflexivity.
  - intros L E T1 T2 wq w0 IH0 E1 x TT E2 Heq. subst.
    apply wf_typ_qall with (L:=L).
    + apply (wf_qua_remove_typ_mid T1 E1 x TT E2). exact wq.
    + intros X HX.
      apply (IH0 X HX (X ~ bind_qua T1 ++ E1) x TT E2).
      rewrite app_assoc. reflexivity.
  - intros E T1 T2 w1 IH1 w2 IH2 E1 x TT E2 Heq. subst.
    apply wf_typ_sum.
    + apply (IH1 E1 x TT E2). reflexivity.
    + apply (IH2 E1 x TT E2). reflexivity.
  - intros E T1 T2 w1 IH1 w2 IH2 E1 x TT E2 Heq. subst.
    apply wf_typ_pair.
    + apply (IH1 E1 x TT E2). reflexivity.
    + apply (IH2 E1 x TT E2). reflexivity.
  - intros E Q T wq wT IHT E1 x TT E2 Heq. subst.
    apply wf_qtyp_qtyp.
    + apply (wf_qua_remove_typ_mid Q E1 x TT E2). exact wq.
    + apply (IHT E1 x TT E2). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_remove_typ_mid : forall (E1:env) x (T:qtyp) (E2:env) S,
  wf_typ (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ T ++ E2) S -> wf_typ (E1 ++ E2) S.
Proof.
  intros. eapply (proj1 wf_typ_qtyp_remove_typ_mid); eauto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_qtyp_remove_typ_mid : forall (E1:env) x (T:qtyp) (E2:env) S,
  wf_qtyp (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ T ++ E2) S -> wf_qtyp (E1 ++ E2) S.
Proof.
  intros. eapply (proj2 wf_typ_qtyp_remove_typ_mid); eauto.
Qed.

(* removal of a middle bind_typ from wf_env *)
Lemma wf_env_remove_typ_mid : forall (E1:env) (x:atom) (T:qtyp) (E2:env),
  wf_env (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ T ++ E2) -> wf_env (E1 ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros E1. induction E1 as [| a E1 IH]; intros x T E2 H.
  - simpl in *. apply wf_env_cons_inv in H. auto.
  - destruct a as [y c]. simpl in *.
    inversion H; subst.
    + eapply wf_env_sub.
      * apply (IH x T E2). eassumption.
      * apply (wf_typ_remove_typ_mid E1 x T E2 T0). eassumption.
      * apply (notin_dom_remove_mid E1 x (bind_typ T) E2 y). eassumption.
    + eapply wf_env_typ.
      * apply (IH x T E2). eassumption.
      * apply (wf_qtyp_remove_typ_mid E1 x T E2 T0). eassumption.
      * apply (notin_dom_remove_mid E1 x (bind_typ T) E2 y). eassumption.
    + eapply wf_env_qua.
      * apply (IH x T E2). eassumption.
      * apply (wf_qua_remove_typ_mid Q E1 x T E2). eassumption.
      * apply (notin_dom_remove_mid E1 x (bind_typ T) E2 y). eassumption.
Qed.

(* ========================================================= *)
(* Environment similarity (same names and binding kinds)      *)
(* ========================================================= *)

Inductive same_kind : binding -> binding -> Prop :=
  | sk_sub : forall T1 T2, same_kind (bind_sub T1) (bind_sub T2)
  | sk_typ : forall T1 T2, same_kind (bind_typ T1) (bind_typ T2)
  | sk_qua : forall Q1 Q2, same_kind (bind_qua Q1) (bind_qua Q2).

Inductive env_sim : env -> env -> Prop :=
  | sim_nil : env_sim nil nil
  | sim_cons : forall x b1 b2 E1 E2,
      same_kind b1 b2 -> env_sim E1 E2 ->
      env_sim ((x,b1)::E1) ((x,b2)::E2).

Lemma same_kind_refl : forall b, same_kind b b.
Proof. intros [T|T|Q]; constructor. Qed.

Lemma env_sim_refl : forall E, env_sim E E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [x b] E IH].
  - constructor.
  - apply sim_cons; [apply same_kind_refl | exact IH].
Qed.

Lemma env_sim_app_tail : forall E1 E2 x b1 b2,
  same_kind b1 b2 -> env_sim E1 E2 ->
  env_sim ((x,b1)::E1) ((x,b2)::E2).
Proof. intros; apply sim_cons; auto. Qed.

Lemma binds_sim_sub : forall E1 E2, env_sim E1 E2 ->
  forall x T, binds x (bind_sub T) E1 -> exists T', binds x (bind_sub T') E2.
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 H. induction H as [| x b1 b2 E1 E2 Hk Hsim IHsim]; intros xx T Hb.
  - destruct Hb.
  - destruct Hb as [Heq|Hb].
    + inversion Heq; subst. inversion Hk; subst. eexists; simpl; left; reflexivity.
    + destruct (IHsim xx T Hb) as [T' HT']. exists T'. apply binds_cons. exact HT'.
Qed.

Lemma binds_sim_typ : forall E1 E2, env_sim E1 E2 ->
  forall x T, binds x (bind_typ T) E1 -> exists T', binds x (bind_typ T') E2.
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 H. induction H as [| x b1 b2 E1 E2 Hk Hsim IHsim]; intros xx T Hb.
  - destruct Hb.
  - destruct Hb as [Heq|Hb].
    + inversion Heq; subst. inversion Hk; subst. eexists; simpl; left; reflexivity.
    + destruct (IHsim xx T Hb) as [T' HT']. exists T'. apply binds_cons. exact HT'.
Qed.

Lemma binds_sim_qua : forall E1 E2, env_sim E1 E2 ->
  forall x Q, binds x (bind_qua Q) E1 -> exists Q', binds x (bind_qua Q') E2.
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 H. induction H as [| x b1 b2 E1 E2 Hk Hsim IHsim]; intros xx Q Hb.
  - destruct Hb.
  - destruct Hb as [Heq|Hb].
    + inversion Heq; subst. inversion Hk; subst. eexists; simpl; left; reflexivity.
    + destruct (IHsim xx Q Hb) as [Q' HQ']. exists Q'. apply binds_cons. exact HQ'.
Qed.

(* ========================================================= *)
(* Well-formedness lemmas: extends and env_sim                *)
(* ========================================================= *)

Lemma wf_qua_extends : forall E E', extends E E' ->
  forall Q, wf_qua E Q -> wf_qua E' Q.
Proof.
  intros E E' Hext Q H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - eapply wf_qua_fvar. apply Hext. exact H.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_qtyp_extends :
  (forall (E:env) (T:typ), wf_typ E T ->
     forall E', extends E E' -> wf_typ E' T) /\
  (forall (E:env) (T:qtyp), wf_qtyp E T ->
     forall E', extends E E' -> wf_qtyp E' T).
Proof.
  apply wf_tq_mut
    with (P := fun E T _ => forall E', extends E E' -> wf_typ E' T)
         (P0 := fun E T _ => forall E', extends E E' -> wf_qtyp E' T).
  - intros E E' He. constructor.
  - intros E E' He. constructor.
  - intros U E X b E' He. eapply wf_typ_var. apply He. exact b.
  - intros E T1 T2 w1 IH1 w2 IH2 E' He. constructor; auto.
  - intros L E T1 T2 w1 IH1 w0 IH0 E' He.
    apply wf_typ_all with (L:=L).
    + apply IH1. exact He.
    + intros X HX. apply (IH0 X HX). apply extends_cons_same. exact He.
  - intros L E T1 T2 wq w0 IH0 E' He.
    apply wf_typ_qall with (L:=L).
    + apply wf_qua_extends with (E:=E); auto.
    + intros X HX. apply (IH0 X HX). apply extends_cons_same. exact He.
  - intros E T1 T2 w1 IH1 w2 IH2 E' He. constructor; auto.

  forall T, wf_qtyp E T -> wf_qtyp E' T.
Proof. intros. eapply (proj2 wf_typ_qtyp_extends); eauto. Qed.

  forall E E', env_sim E E' -> wf_qua E Q -> wf_qua E' Q.
Proof.

    + eapply (wf_qua_sim Q2); eauto.
  - inversion H; subst. constructor.
    + eapply (wf_qua_sim Q1); eauto.
    + eapply (wf_qua_sim Q2); eauto.

  - eapply typing_tapp; [apply (IH1 E' Hext HwfE) | eapply sub_extends; eauto].
  - eapply typing_qabs with (L := L0 \u dom E').
    + eapply wf_qua_extends; eauto.
    + intros X HX.

      assert (HXd : X `notin` dom E') by (exact (notin_union_2 X L0 (dom E') HX)).

      * apply extends_cons_same. exact Hext.

Lemma typing_ctx_extends : forall E Q c T U, typing_ctx E Q c T U ->
  forall E', extends E E' -> wf_env E' -> typing_ctx E' Q c T U.
Proof.
  intros E Q c T U H.
  induction H as [E Q0 T0 w wq wT
    | E Q0 c0 e1 T1 T2 U0 t0 IH t1
    | E Q0 c0 e1 T1 T2 U0 t0 IH v t1
    | L E Q0 c0 T1 T1' T2 U0 t0 IH s w

Require Import Fsub.EffectExclusion.Tactics.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Export Fsub.EffectExclusion.Fsub_LetSum_Lemmas.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import Dev.

Fixpoint lc_exp (e:exp) (d:nat) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | exp_int _ _ => True
  | exp_bvar n => n < d
  | exp_fvar _ => True
  | exp_abs _ _ e1 => lc_exp e1 (S d)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => lc_exp e1 d /\ lc_exp e2 d
  | exp_tabs _ _ e1 => lc_exp e1 (S d)
  | exp_tapp e1 _ => lc_exp e1 d
  | exp_qabs _ _ e1 => lc_exp e1 (S d)
  | exp_qapp e1 _ => lc_exp e1 d
  | exp_let e1 e2 => lc_exp e1 d /\ lc_exp e2 (S d)
  | exp_inl _ e1 => lc_exp e1 d
  | exp_inr _ e1 => lc_exp e1 d
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 => lc_exp e1 d /\ lc_exp e2 (S d) /\ lc_exp e3 (S d)
  | exp_pair _ e1 e2 => lc_exp e1 d /\ lc_exp e2 d
  | exp_first e1 => lc_exp e1 d
  | exp_second e1 => lc_exp e1 d
  | exp_ref _ e1 => lc_exp e1 d
  | exp_ref_label _ _ => True
  | exp_deref e1 => lc_exp e1 d
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => lc_exp e1 d /\ lc_exp e2 d
  | exp_upqual _ e1 => lc_exp e1 d
  | exp_check _ e1 => lc_exp e1 d
  | exp_without _ e1 => lc_exp e1 d
  | exp_do _ => True
  | exp_if0 e1 e2 e3 => lc_exp e1 d /\ lc_exp e2 d /\ lc_exp e3 d
  end.

Fixpoint open_ee_rec_lc (e:exp) {struct e} :
  forall d, lc_exp e d -> forall K f, d <= K -> open_ee_rec K f e = e.
Proof.
  destruct e; intros d H K f HK; simpl in *; try reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (eq_dec K n) as [Heq|Hneq]; [|reflexivity]. exfalso; lia.
  - (* abs *) f_equal. apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ (S d)); [exact H | apply le_n_S; exact HK].
  - (* app *) destruct H as [H1 H2]. f_equal.
    + apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ d); [exact H1 | exact HK].
    + apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ d); [exact H2 | exact HK].
  - (* tabs *) f_equal. apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ (S d)); [exact H | apply le_n_S; exact HK].
  - (* tapp *) f_equal. apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ d); [exact H | exact HK].
  - (* qabs *) f_equal. apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ (S d)); [exact H | apply le_n_S; exact HK].
  - (* qapp *) f_equal. apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ d); [exact H | exact HK].
  - (* let *) destruct H as [H1 H2]. f_equal.
    + apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ d); [exact H1 | exact HK].
    + apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ (S d)); [exact H2 | apply le_n_S; exact HK].
  - (* inl *) f_equal. apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ d); [exact H | exact HK].
  - (* inr *) f_equal. apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ d); [exact H | exact HK].
  - (* case *) destruct H as [H1 [H2 H3]]. f_equal.
    + apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ d); [exact H1 | exact HK].
    + apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ (S d)); [exact H2 | apply le_n_S; exact HK].
    + apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ (S d)); [exact H3 | apply le_n_S; exact HK].
  - (* pair *) destruct H as [H1 H2]. f_equal.
    + apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ d); [exact H1 | exact HK].
    + apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ d); [exact H2 | exact HK].
  - (* first *) f_equal. apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ d); [exact H | exact HK].
  - (* second *) f_equal. apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ d); [exact H | exact HK].
  - (* ref *) f_equal. apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ d); [exact H | exact HK].
  - (* deref *) f_equal. apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ d); [exact H | exact HK].
  - (* set_ref *) destruct H as [H1 H2]. f_equal.
    + apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ d); [exact H1 | exact HK].
    + apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ d); [exact H2 | exact HK].
  - (* upqual *) f_equal. apply (open_ee_rec_lc _ d); [exact H | exact HK].
